question:

choices.A: Women are more likely to suffer from DMD than men.
choices.B: DMD is a sex-linked inherited disease.
choices.C: The rate at which the mutated allele spreads is influenced by the rate at which the associated X chromosome spreads within the population.
choices.D: To develop the condition, a woman must inherit two recessive alleles of this gene.
choices.E: To develop the condition, a man must inherit one of the recessive alleles of this gene.
